```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
gaycinema.df <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/r-lgbtq/tidyrainbow/refs/heads/main/data/LGBTQ-movie-database/movieData.csv")
url <- "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/discover/movie"

queryString <- list(
  include_adult = "true",
  include_video = "true",
  language = "en-US",
  page = "1",
  sort_by = "popularity.desc",
  with_keywords = 'lgbt|gay|lesbian|transgender|bisexual|intersex|queer|genderqueer|non-binary|gender|asexual'
)

response <- VERB("GET", url, query = queryString, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"))

content(response, "text")
```
